segments.title: Cold Open & Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour sign-on as a dog, then transitions to Case Blackwell at the anchor desk for the Friday broadcast.

segments.title: Elon Musk Black Eye & Trump Press Conference
segments.notes: Case and Jeff Ripple cover Elon Musk's black eye (blamed on his son), the Musk-Trump joint press conference, and the Stephen Miller/Katie Miller personnel drama. Includes a viewer poll on the black eye's origin.

segments.title: Jeff Ripple as Hype Train
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple commandeers the hype train role, delivering freestyle raps over subscriber alerts and bit donations while riffing on mortality and roof damage.

segments.title: Debate: Crum's Gorilla Debt & Munch's Death Wish
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate Crum's remaining gambling liability to the mechanical gorilla, Munch's explicit desire for Crum's death, and Kendall's packing ultimatum. No formal debate topic recorded.

segments.title: Corgi Butts Song Production with NeoCore G
segments.notes: DJ C4, a ghost writer, and rapper NeoCore G write, record, and finalize a viewer-requested track titled 'Corgi Butts' under severe time pressure before Kendall's departure deadline.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored the Friday broadcast, managed the Elon Musk/Trump press conference coverage, and oversaw the DJ C4 music production segment.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered the station sign-on in dog persona and managed the DJ C4 segment request toggle.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Co-hosted the news desk, then improvised as Hype Train during a subscription surge, blending donor reads with surreal freestyle.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Debated Crum over the gorilla debt, explicitly stated he wants Crum dead, and revealed his friend Thomas Bahamas Pickles.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Detailed his remaining $100k debt to the mechanical gorilla (7 wins needed), claimed credit for Munch's resurrection, and faced Kendall's packing threat.

characters.name: DJ C4
characters.notes: musical producer. Produced the 'Corgi Butts' beat, coordinated the ghost writer and NeoCore G, and recorded the track under a 40-minute deadline.

characters.name: Ghost Writer
characters.notes: lyricist. Wrote the 'Corgi Butts' lyrics on the fly, leaning heavily on the title and dog-themed word association.

characters.name: NeoCore G
characters.notes: guest artist. Recorded the 'Corgi Butts' vocals in multiple takes, preferring written lyrics over freestyling, and delivered ad-libs on the final pass.

storylines.beat: Crum confirms he owes the mechanical gorilla $100k, earns $15k per debate win (needs 7 more), and faces a face punch if debt uncleared in 8 debates. Munch actively campaigns for Crum's death. [40:30-41:37, 42:48-43:31]
Munch references past Beyblade episodes during debate count banter. [39:25]

lore_notes.fact: Crum's gorilla debt: $100k remaining, $15k per win, 7 wins needed, face punch forfeit if not cleared in 8 debates [40:30-41:37]
Munch was resurrected after Crum relinquished several wins to reach $100k threshold [42:02-42:26]
Kendall threatens to break Crum's nose and drive the bone into his brain if not packed by 4pm [48:44-49:28]
Munch's friend is Thomas Bahamas Pickles; they pretend not to know each other on air [55:22-56:05]

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covered Elon Musk's black eye and exit from the Trump administration alongside a chaotic Trump press conference, then pivoted to a Munch & Crum debate dominated by Crum's mechanical gorilla gambling liability and Munch's explicit death wishes. The broadcast closed with a rushed DJ C4 music production session yielding the track 'Corgi Butts' featuring rapper NeoCore G, all under threat of Kendall's 4pm departure deadline.
